mechanism: Zidovudine may impair vitamin D metabolism and increase risk of bone loss; vitamin D deficiency is common in HIV patients on antiretroviral therapy and may worsen zidovudine-associated bone toxicity.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels in HIV patients on zidovudine; supplement vitamin D as needed to maintain adequate serum levels (typically 30-100 ng/mL) to mitigate bone loss and support immune function.
